It is Microsoft's own transcript, not a news report, so it counts as a primary source.

The rules spell out dates for months and quarters but not seasons, so the exact `due_date` (31 August or about 22 September 2022) is for the human checker to set. The ledger already admitted "this fall" in the 2023-07-25 Security Copilot file, which supports treating a season as dated. Passes, with that note.
